title: Saudi Arabia Military Recruitment 2026: Apply Guide
metaDescription: Saudi Arabia military recruitment 2026: unified admission for men and women, age 18-40, ranks from soldier to sergeant, requirements and how to apply.
headline: Saudi Arabia Military Recruitment 2026: Unified Admission Guide

sections.title: The Unified Recruitment Programme
sections.content:
The Saudi Ministry of Defense runs military recruitment through a single Unified Recruitment Programme, with applications submitted online through the official Joint Military Recruitment portal. The programme covers the Royal Saudi Land Forces, Air Force, Navy, Air Defence and the Strategic Missile Force, and it is open to Saudi men and women.

Ranks on offer run from Soldier (Jundi) and First Soldier through Corporal and Vice Sergeant up to Sergeant (Raqeeb). The Ministry looks for high school graduates, diploma holders and bachelor's degree holders, with priority in 2026 for technical, engineering, cyber security and logistics specialisations under Vision 2030.

sections.title: Eligibility: Nationality, Age and Education
sections.content:
Applicants must be Saudi nationals by origin and upbringing, hold a clean criminal record, and not be current government employees or previously dismissed from military or government service. Male applicants must be at least 18 and not older than 40, while female high school graduates must be at least 21, with maximum ages varying by role.

The minimum height is 160 cm for men and 155 cm for women, with proportionate weight. Women must not be married to a non-Saudi citizen. High school, diploma and bachelor's qualifications are all accepted, and degree holders may enter at higher ranks depending on their specialisation.

sections.title: Officer Colleges: Tougher Academic Rules
sections.content:
Admission to the military colleges for the 1448 AH academic year carries stricter rules than enlisted entry. Applicants must be high school graduates of the current year only, in the natural sciences stream, with at least 80 percent in their secondary certificate, and must score at least 60 percent in both the General Aptitude Test and the Achievement Test.

College applicants must be unmarried, aged 17 to 22, between 165 and 188 cm tall and between 52 and 95 kg, and must pass medical examinations, a personal interview, fitness tests and college-specific aptitude tests. Registration for the colleges opens through the Central Admission Committee portal.

sections.title: Selection Process and How to Apply
sections.content:
Enlisted applicants register through the unified portal with their national ID and Absher credentials, upload academic certificates and Qiyas test results, and then complete a personal interview, medical examination, physical fitness test and specialist assessments. Recruitment windows typically run for around 25 working days, so candidates should watch the portal daily.

Apply only through official government channels: the Ministry of Defense portal and the Jadarat and Taqat platforms. Genuine Saudi military recruitment never charges an application fee, and any agent asking for payment is a scam. Foreigners cannot join combat roles, though civilian technical posts are sometimes filled through private contractors.

faqs.q: Who can apply for Saudi military recruitment in 2026?
faqs.a: Saudi nationals aged 18 to 40 for enlisted roles, with high school, diploma or bachelor's qualifications and a clean record, can apply. Women must be at least 21 if applying with a high school certificate. Only Saudi nationals can join combat roles, and applicants must not be current government employees.

faqs.q: What is the minimum height for Saudi military recruitment?
faqs.a: The minimum height is 160 cm for men and 155 cm for women, with weight proportionate to height. Officer college applicants face a narrower band of 165 to 188 cm and 52 to 95 kg. All candidates must also pass a full medical examination and physical fitness tests.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the Saudi Unified Military Recruitment?
faqs.a: Apply online through the official Joint Military Recruitment portal using your national ID and Absher credentials, uploading your academic certificates and Qiyas test results. Applications are also linked through the Jadarat and Taqat government platforms. Never pay any agent, as official recruitment is completely free.

faqs.q: What are the requirements for Saudi military officer colleges?
faqs.a: College applicants must be current-year science-stream high school graduates with at least 80 percent, score 60 percent or more in the aptitude and achievement tests, be unmarried and aged 17 to 22, and pass medical, interview and fitness assessments. Previous-year graduates are not accepted.
